g.text: Native SwissTrees: search support and reconciliation trade-offs
Initial HMM search on; P = 0, C = 0. A-B: all 2,023 changed pairs. C-D: unchanged input-only family bins.
A: selected direct-search scores identical in both views; homology support is not orthology confidence. Small one-direction counts: TP 6, FP 20.
18 development-exposed families; descriptive overlapping bins, no subgroup intervals or significance claims. Entropy is not divergence; relative shortness is not fragmentation.
Not selected-default superiority or a total-HMM ablation. Failed R-on native timing remains ineligible; no inference timing is displayed.
